notes: Scenarios are intended acceptance tests, not proof current production passes. All exact prayer timing and actor identity should be reconciled to final 1962 liturgical and form contracts.

scenarios.title: LOW_ORDINARY_ONE_COLLECT
scenarios.expectedBehaviorForFutureTests: Opening Collect: one Oremus before the sole Collect, one proper conclusion and response Amen. One Secret; one Postcommunion with same arrangement.

scenarios.title: TWO_COLLECTS_SEPARATE_CONCLUSIONS
scenarios.expectedBehaviorForFutureTests: Oremus twice, both prayers kept in source order with appropriate conclusions/Amen; corresponding two Secrets said secretly with no additional Oremus; Postcommunions mirror the Collect grouping.

scenarios.title: THREE_COLLECTS_GROUP_TWO_THREE
scenarios.expectedBehaviorForFutureTests: Only two Oremus, second and third Collect share the correct second conclusion; three Secrets retain source order without Oremus; Postcommunions mirror opening grouping.

scenarios.title: RITUAL_PRAYER_SAME_CONCLUSION
scenarios.expectedBehaviorForFutureTests: Where explicit law orders a second prayer under one conclusion, one Oremus and one final conclusion/Amen for both; do not apply the separate-conclusions default blindly.

scenarios.title: FERIAL_LENT_EXTRA_SUPER_POPULUM
scenarios.expectedBehaviorForFutureTests: After numbered Postcommunions, add separate Oremus/Humiliate capita vestra Deo and Prayer over the People with own conclusion; before dismissal greeting.

scenarios.title: EMBER_EXTENDED_READINGS
scenarios.expectedBehaviorForFutureTests: Five lessons before Epistle in appointed source order; only qualifying lesson responses, including Daniel exception; Flectamus genua/Levate where appointed; not forced pairs by lesson ordinal.

scenarios.title: MISSA_CANTATA_NO_DEACON
scenarios.expectedBehaviorForFutureTests: Epistle/Gospel and dismissal performer not automatically assigned to deacon/subdeacon. No solemn minister station or Pax imported.

scenarios.title: SOLEMN_DEACON_SUBDEACON
scenarios.expectedBehaviorForFutureTests: Subdeacon Epistle, deacon public Gospel and Ite where required; priest private and schola public timeline separate.

scenarios.title: REQUIEM_CHALICE_AND_AGNUS
scenarios.expectedBehaviorForFutureTests: No blessing of added chalice water, no entrance altar incensation, modified Agnus text and omission of ordinary priest breast strokes; actual rite/form determines dismissal and ending.

scenarios.title: HISTORICAL_SECOND_CONFITEOR_OFF
scenarios.expectedBehaviorForFutureTests: Source C0235–C0241 not visible; after priest's Communion, Ecce Agnus Dei once then three Domine non sum dignus before faithful receive.

scenarios.title: SECOND_CONFITEOR_OPT_IN_ONLY
scenarios.expectedBehaviorForFutureTests: Clearly labelled older/local custom, not normative 1962; never changes the baseline source contract.

scenarios.title: BENEDICAMUS_WITH_PROCESSION
scenarios.expectedBehaviorForFutureTests: Dismissal text/response correct, no final blessing; Last Gospel inclusion decided independently by actual 1962 special rubric/procession structure.

scenarios.title: REQUIEM_DISMISSAL
scenarios.expectedBehaviorForFutureTests: Reply Amen, no priestly final blessing; Last Gospel assessed separately rather than suppressed by a blanket no-blessing rule.

scenarios.title: SUNG_SANCTUS_ASYNC_PRIEST
scenarios.expectedBehaviorForFutureTests: Left/public guide follows heard chant; right/priest state requires an independent event clock, cannot equal reader paragraph position.

scenarios.title: CREDO_CHRISTMAS_ANNUNCIATION
scenarios.expectedBehaviorForFutureTests: Public-song reverence and Christmas/Annunciation exceptional kneeling distinguished from priest's private recitation action; no synthetic universal posture.

scenarios.title: FAITHFUL_POSTURE_UNRESOLVED
scenarios.expectedBehaviorForFutureTests: Left rail uses follow-congregation observational, not fabricated priest-derived kneeling/standing. Right priest clock must independently confirm hidden gestures.

scenarios.title: OFFERTORY_INCENSE_ENABLED
scenarios.expectedBehaviorForFutureTests: Incensation ordered and conditionally rendered; no invented deacon from Solemn forms. People stand to be incensed only with a matching selected/observed community profile.

scenarios.title: ORDINARY_OFFERTORY_NO_INCENSE
scenarios.expectedBehaviorForFutureTests: No C0040–41 or C0120–24 incensation actions or lingering station; restore non-incense priest location.

scenarios.title: LAST_GOSPEL_EXCEPTION
scenarios.expectedBehaviorForFutureTests: No source John 1 when properly omitted; cue C0273 genuflection not fired when Gospel absent.

scenarios.title: GOSPEL_RESPONSES_SPEAKER
scenarios.expectedBehaviorForFutureTests: C0085 Glory to Thee and C0087 Praise to Thee actor roles distinguish congregational/ministerial responses and proclaimed gospel; do not label Gospel minister's voice as priest at altar.
